title: refine skill output schema
description: Schema for a saved refined-input artifact (.context/refinements/*.md). Defines front-matter fields and structural rules. Structural rules below are enforced by scripts/validate-refine.py; JSON Schema covers only the front-matter shape.

file.description: Path under .context/refinements/ where this artifact is saved. Present even for terminal-only runs, as a logical identifier.

original_input.description: Verbatim user text before any clarification.

refined_input.description: The assembled refined input, ready to hand to /trace.

dimensions_addressed.description: Names of dimensions that were explicitly answered during the challenge loop.

dimensions_assumed.description: Dimensions where the value was inferred rather than asked. Each entry records the dimension name and the value assumed.

clarifications.description: The Q&A pairs from the challenge loop, in order.

context_commit.description: Per-repo: the HEAD commit at refinement time, and the commit recorded in the relevant .context/ artifact. Present only when .context/ was available.

hard_stop.description: True if /refine terminated with a hard-stop rather than a resolved refinement. When true, refined_input will be empty and the body contains the hard-stop diagnosis.

structuralRules._note: Not enforced by JSON Schema; enforced by scripts/validate-refine.py.
rules: Every artifact MUST have YAML front-matter delimited by '---' on the first line.
Every artifact MUST begin (after front-matter) with the preamble line: '**Refined input:** <summary> · <input_type> · <N> dimensions addressed, <M> assumed'.
A '## Original Input' section MUST be present, containing the verbatim original input.
A '## Refined Input' section MUST be present. If hard_stop is true, this section contains the hard-stop diagnosis instead of a refined input.
A '## Assumptions' section MUST be present if dimensions_assumed is non-empty.
A '## Clarification Log' section MUST be present if clarifications is non-empty.
If hard_stop is true, a '## How to Rephrase' section MUST be present with concrete guidance.
refined_input in front-matter MUST differ structurally from original_input UNLESS the artifact is a round-trip pass (in which case a '## Round-Trip' section noting this MUST be present).
Every dimension name in dimensions_addressed MUST appear in the canonical dimension list for the input_type.
Every dimension name in dimensions_assumed MUST appear in the canonical dimension list for the input_type.

canonicalDimensions._note: Enforced by validate-refine.py for dimensions_addressed and dimensions_assumed.
